title: Completed tensor extension of a normalized completion comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y with l invertible in every residue field. For any PodCompletionReindex D satisfying its Laws, there exists a PodCompletedTensorReindex T over that same D satisfying all its Laws: forward and reverse strict tensor generators, strict-tower naturality, derived naturality, the full two-coordinate Roos Model equation, and equality with the specified canonical completed pullback/tensor comparison. No ambient completeness or boundedness condition is added to D. Definitions: [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-pod-completion-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-tensor-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization].

proof.text: on simultaneous flat-term K-flat P,Q, use the quotient maps in D and the sectionwise balanced tensor comparison to relabel every (p,q) summand. The two orders of applying a quotient transition agree on x tensor y, so these maps assemble into an isomorphism of strict towers. The inverse relabels in reverse. Both differentials send a generator to dx tensor y + (-1)^p x tensor dy, proving that these are chain maps. Their naturality follows on the same generators. Reindexing preserves the common cohomological interval and constructibility of every finite reduction. The Roos comparison in D and its limit model transport derived completeness, so it preserves the complete constructible domain. Apply D.roos followed by the tower isomorphism, and descend along the two K-flat localizations to define the tensor isomorphism. This gives Model and Naturality. The finite generator formula is the canonical finite pullback/tensor map. D.Unit and D.Counit compare its whole-system realization with the specified completed pullback comparison, proving Canonical before finite evaluation. These constructions also apply to zero complexes and empty schemes. .

lean.statement:
theorem podReindexingTensorConstruction
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D) :
    ∃ T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D,
      PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T
